_comment: PCT manifest for the Rust port. Mirrors the Java pct_*_native.json shape (adapter + exclusions). Each exclusion entry maps a test FQN to a substring of the failure message that confirms the test is failing for the documented reason. apply_exclusion (crates/runtime/src/native/testing.rs) flips matching FAIL/ERROR results to PASS, and flips PASS results back to FAIL with 'PCT exclusion needs rebase' so stale exclusions can't go quiet.
